topic: A person discovers the tree they planted as a child has been cut down
text: M'lord, I heard ye speak of the tree ye planted back when ye were but a lad. I know it held much meaning for ye, a mark of yer youth and the passage of time. The land, it seems, remembers no man, and the needs of the present sometime overshadow the sentiments of the past. The tree, it had to go—space is precious, and the lord needed the land for crops to feed the village. We all do what we must to see the next harvest, don’t we? I hope, in time, the earth may yield enough to ease the pain of what's lost.
